analogy.rationale: HSP inducers activate HSF1 and the heat-shock transcriptional program, which overlaps strongly with HSP inhibitors that also engage chaperone/HSF1 feedback and proteotoxic stress responses; proteasome inhibition and oxidative stress also trigger heat-shock and unfolded-protein responses, while HDAC and translation inhibitors cause milder proteostatic stress.
